build_coco_metric_evaluator: build a CocoMetric instance to evaluate bbox and segm metrics on a COCO dataset with custom IoU thresholds
test_fast_eval_recall: test the fast_eval_recall method to compute averaged recall for object detection proposals against ground truth bboxes
refactor_results2json: refactor the results2json method to convert detection results including bboxes and masks into COCO format JSON files
review_gt_to_coco_json: review the gt_to_coco_json method that converts ground truth annotations into a COCO format JSON file for evaluation
summarize_compute_metrics: summarize the compute_metrics method that calculates mAP, AR, and classwise precision metrics using COCOeval
